title: A drunk raccoon raised $250,000
source_title: 'Remarkable': Drunk raccoon leads to $250,000 for Hanover Animal Control
description: A raccoon was caught drunk inside a liquor store in Hanover County, Virginia. A year later a campaign in his name has raised a quarter of a million dollars for the animal control team.

beats.narration: A drunk raccoon just raised a quarter of a million dollars. Yes, really.
beats.title: A drunk raccoon raised $250,000
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: About a year ago, in Hanover County, Virginia, a raccoon was captured inside a liquor store. And he was drunk.
beats.title: Caught inside a liquor store
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: Wait. Drunk? The raccoon was drunk? How does a raccoon even pay for that?
beats.title: Wait, drunk?
beats.speaker: guest

beats.narration: He did not pay. That is why animal control had to come and collect him.
beats.title: He did not pay
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: Okay. So that is the end of the story. Sad little hangover, everyone goes home.
beats.title: So that is the end
beats.speaker: guest

beats.narration: No. The internet found out. A campaign started in his name, and it has now raised two hundred and fifty thousand dollars for that same animal control team.
beats.title: A quarter of a million dollars
beats.speaker: host

beats.narration: So I stay sober all year and get a tax bill, and he has one wild night and funds a whole department. I picked the wrong career.
beats.title: I picked the wrong career
beats.speaker: guest

beats.narration: Subscribe, and we will bring you another weird but true story tomorrow.
beats.title: New true story tomorrow
